task.title: Filter settings by source
task.shortdesc: Filter configured settings by baseline, CIS, manual, imported, or raw source attribution.

prereq.p: Open All settings in Configured mode or a source-aware list.

context.p: Source filters explain why a value exists. They help distinguish generated baselines, CIS layers, manual edits, imported policies, and raw fallback values.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Choose baseline, CIS, manual, imported, or raw depending on the question you are answering.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Review the list count and visible badges after each filter change.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Clear the filter before switching to a different investigation path.

info.note: Changing settings can affect the exported Firefox policy. Review source, validation, and schema support before saving.

result.p: The visible list contains only settings from the selected source category.

postreq.p: Recovery: if a setting disappears, clear source filters and inspect its detail panel for the recorded source.
